full_description: In the KitchenS bar scene, press and hold the beer tap button to pour into the beer mug under the spout. Flow runs while the button is held and stops when released. Foaminess of the stream rises the longer the button stays held and resets when released. Pause to settle foam, then finish, release fully, and wait before done. Overflow fails.
